notes: DOMAIN: coincasa.it 301-redirects to www.coin.it/it-it/ (Coincasa is now the home department of the merged Coin department-store site, Salesforce Commerce Cloud). All links are the live coin.it canonical origin URLs, per the prior Home-Decor pass finding. ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, own tab, no HTTP-layer fetches from outside the browser. robots.txt (https://www.coin.it/robots.txt) disallows only /cart, /login, /account for User-agent: * -- no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai directive, no site-wide disallow. TREE: taken from the rendered SHOP CASA mega-menu on the homepage and cross-checked against the category sitemap https://www.coin.it/it-it/sitemap_0-category.xml (3124 URLs). The sitemap confirms /shop-casa/mobili/ has EXACTLY four children (complementi-d'arredo, divani-poltrone-e-pouf, sedie-e-sgabelli, tavoli) and no third level, and /shop-casa/outdoor/ has five children of which only mobili-da-giardino is furniture. COUNTS: the site's own rendered listing header 'N Prodotti' -- server-rendered, so it is identical in the raw HTML; captured via same-origin fetch() from the loaded coin.it page context and verified against the live rendered page in the tab for /outdoor/mobili-da-giardino/ ('9 Prodotti', h1 'Mobili da giardino', canonical matches). Every h1 was checked to match the requested slug (no silent parent fallback). Counts discriminate: 19 / 6 / 3 / 3 / 6 / 9 all differ. SANITY: parent Mobili = 19 Prodotti, children sum to 18 -- the difference is 'Set di sedia a dondolo e poggiapiedi Relax', which sits directly under Mobili and under Outdoor > Mobili da giardino but in none of the four Mobili children; I did NOT sum children and did NOT emit Mobili as a leaf. The site's count counts colour/ID variants (Sedie e Sgabelli reports 3 for 2 distinct slugs), which is the site's own number and is what is recorded. OVERLAP: 8 of the 9 products in Outdoor > Mobili da giardino also appear under Mobili's children (the outdoor pieces are dual-filed); both nodes are kept because they are genuinely distinct listing pages with distinct URLs and names, and the overlap is flagged. INCLUDED after opening each listing and reading the product tiles: Complementi d'arredo (balcony set, 2-armchair+dining-table set, outdoor bar cart, bistro set, 2 coat racks -- all furniture/hall furniture, no decor objects), Divani poltrone e pouf (2 velvet sofa beds + 1 velvet pouf), Sedie e Sgabelli (velvet stools), Tavoli (outdoor side table, graphite console, aluminium side table, glass side table, Movida table, Movida bar table), Mobili da giardino. EXCLUDED after inspection: Soggiorno > Arredo soggiorno -- despite the 'arredo' (furnishing) name, its 19 products are cotton throws, doorstops, a candle, a laptop sleeve, rugs and a framed mirror, i.e. textiles/decor, NOT furniture (title-scanned all 17 distinct slugs). Camera da letto (all 8 children are bedding: duvet covers, sheets, pillowcases, quilts, duvets/pillows) -- no beds or bedroom case goods anywhere on the site. Bagno (towels, bathrobes, bath accessories, soaps, bath mats) -- no vanity units or bathroom furniture. Illuminazione interni (lighting), Soggiorno > Specchi (mirrors), Tessili casa, Tavola e cucina, Cura/organizzazione/decorazione casa (decor), Outdoor > Teli mare, Picnic e tempo libero, Giardinaggio, Lanterne e vasi da esterno. NEVER-EXTRACT branches dropped per rule: /shop-casa/outlet/ (incl. its own outlet/casa/mobili/divani, pouf-e-poltrone, tavoli, complementi-d'arredo), /it-it/saldi/casa/mobili/ (sale re-cut), Festa d'Estate, Aria di Bianco, Anteprima Aria di Bianco, Anteprima Festa d'Estate, Coin Days, La tavola di primavera, Editoriali, Regali, and the /en-it/ English-locale mirror of the same tree. Accessori per animali (pet accessories) not treated as furniture. No flat SEO-style furniture landing categories exist -- the only single-segment category URL in the sitemap besides departments is the 'tazze' mugs page from the prior pass. The overall furniture catalogue here is genuinely tiny (19 SKUs); Coin/Coincasa is a decor-and-textiles department store that carries only a small seasonal furniture assortment.
